title: DGX Spark training on NVKE

scenes.heading: Bring up one DGX Spark
voice: You have one DGX Spark and want a training stack.
A preview on the AICR main branch targets that GB10 device.

scenes.heading: Make the runtime usable by Kubernetes
scenes.sub: Check the DGX OS container runtime
voice: The recipe expects the host driver already supplied by DGX OS.
Before deploying, use a containerd configuration with the Container Runtime Interface enabled.

scenes.heading: Choose a compatible training image
scenes.sub: Use the Kubeflow variant for the Trainer
voice: Resolve the NVKE training recipe for GB10 and Ubuntu with Kubeflow selected.
That choice adds Trainer to the bundle, and your TrainJob should specify an Arm64 image that suits Spark.

scenes.heading: Validate the one-node installation
voice: After deploying the bundle, run the deployment and conformance checks.
This example focuses on bringing up one Spark and getting usable validation results for that node.

viewer: Developer preparing a single DGX Spark for training
payoff: Verify CRI and Arm64 workload compatibility before deploying and validating the single-node GB10 preview on NVKE.
